observed_problem: The compact agent-first Stage Checkpoint requires lifecycle-specific artifact names and hashes, but the canonical hot path did not itself run the strong deterministic stage semantic validators that existed behind the legacy Handoff path. For several stages a same-named repository-local file could therefore be checkpointed without proving that it was the accepted Screening/Evidence/Selection/Draft/Validation authority. Draft checkpoints also bound synthesis input/result but did not require the underlying paired Draft Package/Result authorities that the synthesis builder validated.
expected_behavior: The agent-first hot path must remain compact while preserving deterministic stage-contract validation. Before a lifecycle transition, a deterministic stage-validation result must validate the exact supplied/current upstream artifacts under the current reviewed contract, bind its result to those exact artifacts and State, and be required by the compact controller. Content-addressed accepted artifacts may remain dynamically located, but their semantic/content-addressed identity must be validated rather than trusted from their display name.
actual_behavior: scripts/survey_stage_validation_v2.py now validates the exact stage artifact set through the strong underlying Discovery/Screening/Evidence/Selection/Architecture/Draft/Quality/Publication/Freeze contracts and emits a CORE_STAGE_CONTRACT result bound to State, Profile, lifecycle, current implementation, current contract and exact artifact paths/SHA-256 values. Draft validation requires paired draft-package:<id>/draft-result:<id> authorities. survey_agent_control_v2.py requires exactly one deterministic CORE_STAGE_CONTRACT review and independently reconciles every bound field before creating or advancing a compact Stage Checkpoint, so a same-named file or fabricated PASS JSON is insufficient.

provenance.human_review_reference: Post-change five-perspective audit requested by Owner, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Implemented a compact deterministic stage-contract validation authority and made the agent controller require/reconcile its exact result without reintroducing Action/Handoff ceremony.
